message.reasoning:
We need to produce JSON with cases array, coverage_map, open_questions. Must have IDs API-001 etc sequential, no gaps. Between 15 and 25 cases. Must cover each coverage area with at least one positive and at least one negative/boundary/security.

Coverage areas: auth token validation, CRUD operations, error handling (4xx/5xx), rate limiting, schema validation.

We need cases each with fields: id pattern API-###, module "api", title length 10-120, coverage_area one of list, type one of list, priority P0/P1/P2, preconditions array strings, test_data object, steps array strings, expected_results array strings, automation_candidate boolean, notes string.

We must ensure each case tests one behavior only.

We need coverage_map mapping each area to list of IDs.

We need open_questions maybe none.

Let's design about 18 cases.

Plan:

API-001: auth token validation positive: admin obtains token and uses it to GET /api/v1/test-cases. Positive.

API-002: auth token validation negative: missing token returns 401 missing_token.

API-003: auth token validation security: token with wrong signature returns 401 invalid_token.

API-004: CRUD operations positive: admin creates new test case via POST, then GET by id returns it.

API-005: CRUD operations read list pagination positive: viewer GET list page 1 page_size 5 returns correct items count and fields.

API-006: CRUD operations update positive: admin PATCH title of existing case, verify updated_at changes.

API-007: CRUD operations delete positive: admin DELETE case, then GET returns 404.

API-008: CRUD operations negative: viewer attempts POST, gets 403 forbidden.

API-009: error handling 4xx negative: POST test case with duplicate title (case-insensitive) returns 409 duplicate_title.

API-010: error handling 5xx: inject DB fault, GET test case returns 500 internal_error, then reset and retry succeeds.

API-011: rate limiting positive: make 60 requests within minute, all succeed.

API-012: rate limiting negative: 61st request returns 429 rate_limited with Retry-After header.

API-013: schema validation positive: GET token response matches schema (fields exactly). Could be same as API-001 but we need separate case focusing on schema. Use admin token request and verify response fields.

API-014: schema validation negative: GET test case with extra field? Not possible. Maybe verify that response does not contain unexpected fields; but that's positive. Could be boundary: test title max length 200 characters accepted, response includes trimmed title. That's more CRUD. But we need schema validation negative? Actually requirement: each area needs at least one positive and at least one negative, boundary or security case. For schema validation we have positive case (API-013). Need a negative/boundary/security case for schema validation: maybe request with malformed JSON returns 422 validation_error, and response body matches error schema (error code, message). That's error handling though. But we can treat as schema validation of error response shape. So API-014: schema validation boundary: request with invalid JSON returns 422 and response matches error schema exactly.

API-015: auth token validation boundary: token expiry after 3600 seconds, advance clock, request returns 401 token_expired.

API-016: CRUD operations boundary: title length exactly 200 characters accepted; create case with 200 chars, verify success.

API-017: CRUD operations negative: PATCH with title blank after trim returns 422 validation_error (title). (But that's error handling). Could be separate.

But we already have many. Need ensure each case unique.

Let's list final cases:

2 API-002 auth token validation negative missing token
3 API-003 auth token validation security wrong signature
4 API-004 auth token validation boundary token expiry
5 API-005 CRUD operations positive create
6 API-006 CRUD operations positive read list pagination
7 API-007 CRUD operations positive update
8 API-008 CRUD operations positive delete

13 API-013 rate limiting negative exceed limit
14 API-014 schema validation positive token response schema
15 API-015 schema validation negative error response schema for 422
16 API-016 schema validation boundary title max length
17 API-017 non_functional maybe? Not required but we can have extra.

We need between 15 and 25, we have 16. Good.

Define preconditions: e.g., for token cases need reset hook.

Steps: strings.

Expected_results: precise messages.
